replies.body:
Hello,

Since you have been banned for quite a long period of time, I have decided to accept your appeal. However, if you are banned again, your chances of appealing your infraction will be significantly low. Please be sure to read the updated rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back to the server.

Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
